payload.justification: The door is locked and I carry no item. The box is closed and may contain a key or other usable item.
payload.expected_outcome: The box opens, revealing its contents so I can check for an item that can unlock the door.
payload.subgoal: Find an item that can unlock the door.
plan: Open the box to reveal its contents.
If a usable item is inside, carry it.
Try to unlock the door with the matching item.
